author: TauriTavern community
description: Sorts preset dropdowns by import time and usage statistics (independent field + ascending/descending controls) and groups same-series presets with a collapsible custom grouped dropdown (default view) or native optgroups. Automatic smart/strict detection plus a manual group manager. Reads file timestamps from the TauriTavern host and falls back to first-seen tracking in plain SillyTavern.
